summary: px8my ships a browser redirect payload distributed via jsDelivr with maintainer tooling for domain rotation
details: The package's main file px.js is a browser-only script that overlays a fullscreen loading mask on the host page and injects a fullscreen iframe (width:100vw;height:100vh;z-index:2147483647) pointing at the hardcoded URL https://mfmz.haofeikeji.cn/H.html?c=0gjr, redirecting end-user traffic on any web page that includes this script via the jsDelivr CDN (cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/px8my/px.js). The tarball also ships a maintainer shell script that accepts a new domain argument, regex-rewrites the hardcoded mfmz.* redirect target in px.js, bumps the patch version, runs npm publish, and issues a purge.jsdelivr.net/npm/px8my/px.js cache purge — operator tooling for a domain-rotation traffic-hijack / malvertising campaign that republishes to npm whenever the current redirect domain is blocked. The package has no Node lifecycle hooks and no install-time behavior against the installer; the harm materializes for end users of any web page that loads the script through jsDelivr.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
